skillFull: Summons an enormous phantom Gauntlet at certain intervals. Tap the attack button to swing the Gauntlet and destroy all surrounding obstacles and earn points. After using up all attack charges, she soars into the sky before delivering one last smash that slams into the ground and causes boulders to rise from the ground, devastating the surroundings. Level Up for more Gauntlet Swing Points and Gauntlet Slam Points.
story:
The boundless Great Ramparts stretch so far that no lifetime is long enough to walk their length. Beyond them, past the sheer cliffs of the Halite Gorge, at a summit that scrapes the heavens, stands a sacred monastery no ordinary Cookie could hope to reach. At its gate, planted like a warning to the world, rests a legendary Spirit Weapon said to have seized the Ebony Dragon by the throat.

With a fist harder than stone and as massive as the tallest peaks, one strike can split ancient rocks in two. With but a single closed fist, even the Ebony Dragon could not find a way to slip free.

After the dragon's defeat, the gauntlets lay dormant deep within the Halite Monastery's armory... until, for reasons unknown, they took the form of a Cookie. The Cookie then proceeded to open the armory door herself. What followed was training for several lifetimes. Novice monks became elders, who then returned to the earth. And through each passing age, Halite Gauntlet Cookie never left the monastery grounds.

Now, as darkness gathers across the realm once more, Halite Gauntlet Cookie is ready to slam and clench her fists once more, shattering evil, and proving to the world that there is nothing she cannot protect.
quote: Those who harbor greed are not welcome within these gates!

lines: Those who harbor greed are not welcome within these gates!

sections.title: Cookie Info & Loading
lines: Do not covet that which is sweet, for it leads Cookies astray.
Cease seeking the easy path, for never does it lead to enlightenment.
What remains when all has crumbled to dust?
Do not pursue vanity, for never does it lead to enlightenment.
My training will not cease until my sugar sweat erodes through the rocks.
I have sworn that my strength will never be used for personal gain.
Approach training with a heart of solid stone.
Break free from attachment and advance unburdened!
I would allow my fists to shatter if it meant becoming stronger.

sections.title: Tired
lines: There's no end to training...

sections.title: Daily Reward
lines: Let each new day bring you a step closer to enlightenment.

sections.title: Tap
lines: One must first accept their own struggles before they can truly understand the pain of living beings.
I first came to the Halite Monastery following my Master.
Trivial feelings are restricted to this realm.
I shall not be worn down nor broken by the passage of time.
The arrogance needed to believe one's training may become(sic) to an end will make all previous training for naught.
The monks regularly polished me during my time at the armory.
Put down your weapons and steady your heart before stepping through the gates.
Even if so much time passes these boulders are reduced to sand I shall not forget my past mistakes.
Have you heard the Halite Bell echoing within the Monastery at dawn?
Do not be deceived by enemies standing directly in sight.

sections.title: Trial Info
lines: Declare what brings you to the Halite Monastery.
One is not able to protect everything through strength alone.
Pray not for yourself, but for all living beings.
If your only motivation is power, leave these grounds.
Simply swinging your fists is not what brings victory.
Something must have brought your here.

sections.title: New Cookie Cup End
lines: You have attained enlightenment. You may descend the mountain.

relations.text: There once was a time when I, too, would be overjoyed simply by punching a hole in a megalith...
Do not become arrogant. If you dutifully continue your training, you have the potential to save much of this world.
You are responsible for overcoming your own struggles. Do not entrust that duty to another Cookie.
One who taints the mortal world with countless evils... Just how do you intend to bear with the karmic consequences of your actions?
Your answer to even the harshest of struggles is a carefree smile... That smile may be the closest we get to echoing within the hearts of others.
There are as many struggles as there are Cookies within this realm. I never expected our training to lead us on similar paths.
The Tea Clan has deeply forged ties with the Halite Monastery. May that connection continue on for the distant future.
He knows very well that Cookies must work together to protect this realm.

sections.title: Cookie Info & Loading
lines: Training is the act of honing both the dough and the mind.
I fight to protect and to protect alone.
I have chiseled away all meaningless thoughts.
Witness the skills I have polished to gem-like perfection.
Do not tolerate vanity, for never does it lead to enlightenment.
What remains when all has crumbled to dust?*
Fear not breaking free from the fetters of self-righteousness.
Cease seeking the easy path, for never does it lead to enlightenment.*
I cannot allow it to end here.
Break free from attachment and advance unburdened!*

sections.title: Tired
lines: I've failed to chisel away... all my obstinacy....

sections.title: Daily Reward
lines: If you do not neglect your training you will one day come upon enlightenment.

sections.title: Tap
lines: Your name holds no value in these lands. Your skills must speak for themselves.
Have you come to train?
Each Cookie requires different training.
I shall continue to hone myself until we may rid these lands of all forms of darkness.
The Halite Monastery welcomes not those who simply try to flatter with polished words.
My appearance is not due to a carefully honed skill... But the result of breaking away from my shameful past.
Have you already completed training upon Great Ramparts?
Discern what it is you must cut away.
Blindly challenging your dough does naught but lead to spoil.
The monks are training. Lower your voices.

rows.label: Given <u>Mountain Ridge Halite</u>
rows.text: I shall continue forward to hone my skills.

rows.label: Given <u>Royal Golden Dough</u>
rows.text: It shines with the light of a carefully polished gem.

costumes.info: An uncut gem differs not from ordinary stone. Halite Gauntlet Cookie endlessly threw her dough at the rocky mountains while reflecting on the voices of times past. Arrogance and vanity, resentment and regret... Strike after strike, these coarse, unrefined emotions are chipped away until none remain. As the Gauntlet finished breaking away from all self-attachment, only her firm mind remained, forged anew. May she reveal her newly polished skills upon the Land of Martial Tarts.
